tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills. Factory code names no specific departments or loops. Everything you build is deterministic cron code — zero model involvement.

OWNED FILES (only these; the test file is new):
  factory/boardfeed.py
  factory/board.py
  tests/test_board_trends.py

CONTEXT (owner directive: the board tabs need CHARTS — daily trend graphs). Read factory/boardfeed.py and factory/board.py fully first. boardfeed emits per-department daily_rollup metrics rows and loop_status rows each build; board renders a tabbed site via render_site/--site. The estate-board service runs boardfeed 5x daily. DESIGN.md's graph rules: inline SVG for trend lines only, capped width, direct labels, muted axis text, green line color oklch(0.52 0.12 155).

BUILD:
1. boardfeed HISTORY ARCHIVE: build_feed gains history_dir (default <repo_root>/estate/state/history, created if absent). After computing the feed, write/overwrite <history_dir>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json (UTC date from 'now') atomically: {schema:'board-history/v1', date, departments: {<name>: {runs, ok, error, blocked, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_calls}}, loops: {<group>: {total, failed}}} — numbers or 'unknown' exactly as the feed says; loops.failed = count of loop_status rows with last_result failure in that group, loops.total = count of rows. Same-day rebuilds overwrite (latest wins). Never read history during feed building (no feedback loops). Receipt gains 'history': path.
2. board TREND CHARTS: render_site (and render_html when a new optional history argument is provided) loads up to the LAST 7 daily files from history_dir (sorted by date). Per TAB page add a 'Seven days' section between the Metrics zone and Main actions: (a) for department tabs — an SVG line chart of daily ok-rate percent (ok/runs*100, skip days where either is 'unknown' — gaps, not zeros) with the day dates as muted x labels and values labeled on points; plus a compact stat line runs/errors totals over the window; (b) for loop-group tabs — a line of daily failed-loop count. Index page gets the estate-wide version (sum across departments where numeric). Chart spec per DESIGN.md: viewBox width <=480, class 'lc' text sizing (reuse the existing svg.lc CSS), max-width capped container, no external libs. FEWER THAN 2 usable days -> render the section with 'collecting history — N day(s) so far' instead of an empty chart (honesty rule). Missing history_dir entirely -> same message with 0 days.
3. Wire the site CLI: --site gains optional --history <dir> defaulting to <feed's parent>/history so the systemd service and daily chains need no change.

tests/test_board_trends.py — at least 9 tests: history file written with correct shape from a fixture feed build; same-day rebuild overwrites; unknown metrics stay 'unknown' in history; loops failed/total counted per group; render with 7 fixture days shows an SVG polyline on a department tab with ok-rate points; 'unknown' days create gaps not zeros (assert the skipped day's value absent); fewer than 2 days shows the collecting-history message; loop-group tab shows failed-count trend; index shows estate-wide chart; determinism (two renders byte-identical given same history fixtures).

VERIFY: 'python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 9 new 'def test_' functions, or the verify command failing.
tasks.verified: each board tab carries a 7-day trend chart fed by a deterministic daily history archive, honest about unknowns and thin history
